title: Canonical tensor-pullback composition and global section unit
statement: Let $A,B,C$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], with ordinary module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and tensor pullbacks $a^*$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. Use the canonical tensor-pullback adjunction $a^*\dashv a_*$ of [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], whose unit sends a section to its tensor $1\otimes s$. For composable scheme maps $a:A\to B$ and $b:B\to C$, define tensorSectionsComp to be the natural isomorphism $c_{a,b}:a^*b^*\simeq(b\circ a)^*$ obtained by adjunction conjugacy from the canonical sectionwise pushforward composition identification $(b\circ a)_*\simeq b_*a_*$. Equivalently this is the inverse-oriented composition comparison of [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso] for $k=b\circ a$ and the reflexive triangle equation; the specified adjunctions fix its unit normalization. For a scheme map $a:A\to B$ and an arbitrary ordinary module $G$ on $B$, define tensorSectionsUnit to be the additive map $\Gamma(B,G)\to\Gamma(A,a^*G)$ obtained by evaluating the adjunction unit $G\to a_*a^*G$ on the whole of $B$ and restricting from $a^{-1}(B)$ to the whole of $A$ by the canonical equality $a^{-1}(B)=A$. These are definitions on arbitrary module sheaves, with no quasi-coherence, invertibility, or etaleness assumption and no presheaf-functoriality assertion.

source.place: Tag 03DR, Section quasi-coherent-sheaves, equation-quasi-coherent-presheaf (35.8.1): the canonical pullback-of-sections construction and its composition comparison, restricted to the small etale site in Tag 03DU. The concrete definitions are the global-section adjunction unit and the conjugate of pushforward composition; this node owns those maps, not the theorem that their restrictions form a presheaf.

def tensorSectionsComp {A B C : Scheme.{u}} (a : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ C) :
    tensorPullback b ⋙ tensorPullback a ≅ tensorPullback (a ≫ b)
